title: The footprint of a metrics-based research evaluation system on Spain's philosophical scholarship: an analysis of researchers' perceptions
benchmark_measurement: This paper does not contain a benchmark and does not measure any aspect of faith or religion. It is an analysis of researchers' perceptions of a metrics-based research evaluation system in the field of philosophy in Spain.
findings: This paper does not have any findings related to religion. Its key findings are that the research evaluation system in Spain is widely perceived by philosophy researchers to negatively affect research behavior, publication practices, research agendas, teaching, and mental health, while also increasing research misconduct. Positive effects, mentioned to a lesser extent, include increased research productivity and enhanced transparency in academic selection processes.
